tei:div.tei:p: bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang mdzub ston 'og /nged zhib 'jug khang nas ma dpe 'tshol bsdu dang legs sgrig byas pa brgyud rin bral gyi gsung rab dag srung skyob ky-i khrod du/ paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i gsung ngag rin po che snang gsum snying po'i legs bshad dang*/ rgyud gsum snying po'i legs bshad 'di gnyis bzhag ste/ mkhyen brtse 'od snang zhes pa'i dpe tshogs kyi khongs su btang stai nges 'byung gi dbugs rgyun ma chad cing*/ shes rab kyi spyan ma ldongs pa'i dam pa rnams la rin bral legs skyes shig tu phul ba yin/ nang don thad gsung ngag rin po che snang gsum snying po'i legs bshad las ni thog mar man ngag gi byung tshul/ bar du byung ba'i chos la bshad sgrub bya tshul/ tha mar sgrub pa mthar phyin nas gzhan don bya tshul bcas don gsum du bsdus te/ theg pa gsum gyi thun mong gi lam gyi nyams len ma lus pa gcig tu dril shing*/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab zab mo mdo rgyud thams cad kyi don gyi bcud phyung ba/ grub chen bi rū'u pa'i bzhed gzhung*/ sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma dag las rim pa brgyud pa'i gsang chen rgyud sde'i nges gsang mtha' yas pa dag la thog mar sngon 'gro snang ba gsum gyi sgo nas lam du dkri ba'i sgo dam pa gyur pa'i ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pas snang gsum mdzes rgyan gyis dmigs rim gal che ba rnams/ las dang po bas go bde ba'i phyir mdzub khrid du bkod pa zhig dang*/ gsung ngag rin po che'i dngos gzhi'i khrid rim rgyud gsum snying po'i legs bshad ni thog mar sngon 'gro snang ba gsum gyi sgo nas lam du dkris shing de nyid nyams len gyi dngos gzhi rgyud gsum la 'jug tshul don gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa ste/ rgyu chos can 'khor ba'i gnas tshul/

lam ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul/ 'bras bu mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi sa bshad pa bcas kyis ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pas rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan gyis bstan pa'i gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag nyams su len pa'i gang zag dag la nyams len gyi dmigs rim gal che ba dag phyogs gcig tu go bder bkod cing*/ mdor na nang chos nyams len mkhan rnams la mig ltar gces pa'i gzhung zhig tu snang ngo*/ /dpe tshogs 'di'i ma dpe 'tshol bsdu dang dpe sgrig 'gan 'dzin pa 'gro 'dul rdo rje dang*/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/ thub bstan nyi ma/ karma bde legs bcas dang*/ rtsis 'khor du phab pa'i 'gan khur ba zla ba dang*/ blo bzang chos 'phel gnyis/ zhus dag dang*/ sdeb bzo/ mdzes bkod sogs dpal brtsegs las zhor slob ma'i bgyis shing legs par grub pa'o/ / mjug tu ngas ma dpe mkho 'don mdzad mkhan ngor e waṃ chos sde'i mkhan slob rnams la thugs rje che zhu/ zhes dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas thub bstan nyi mas/
bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/dpe skrun gsal bshad/ -PAGE 2--PAGE 3--PAGE 1-
